units.source_text: "义满逝世后，避其遗嘱，将北山殿改为排刹，称做鹿苑寺。

en.t: After Yoshimitsu's death, in deference to his will, Kitayama-dono was converted into a Zen temple and called Rokuon-ji.

units.source_text: 其建筑物有的他迁，有的荒芜，惟有金阁幸存下来……"

en.t: Some of its buildings were moved elsewhere, and others fell into ruin; only the Golden Pavilion was fortunate enough to survive..."
